r7_reproducibility_component.defect: C4C3's venv lived in a per-session temporary directory and its reproduce_command pinned only 13 packages, leaving the resolved narwhals unpinned

durable_environment.evidence: path is under the LOCAL_COURTS qualification estate on the operating host; grep for /var/folders and /private/var/folders both return 0 matches
durable_environment.commit_note: the commission forbids committing a venv and none was committed

why_this_is_not_per_session_temporary: C4C3's venv was /var/folders/78/.../T/opencode/c4c3-env, which the OS may reap. This one is a named directory on the host's persistent volume with a stable absolute path.

complete_recipe.note: pip and setuptools come from the venv itself and are pinned explicitly to keep the 13-package historical subset hash stable

historical_positive_control.claim: the accepted historical C3 environment seed must reproduce byte-for-byte
historical_positive_control.method: take the 14-entry resolved freeze, remove the three C4 additions (pyreadstat, pyarrow, narwhals), add pip==22.3.1 and setuptools==65.5.0, sort, LF-terminate, SHA-256
historical_positive_control.significance: a POSITIVE CONTROL, not a test-suite pass: the durable environment reproduces the accepted historical seed exactly, evidencing no drift on any of the 13 historical packages

caveats.caveat: The base interpreter is NOT version-controlled. It exists on this host only, now fully digest-identified. A different host cannot obtain it from Git.
A dangling symlink LOCAL_COURTS/tooling/python/cpython-3.11-macos-x86_64-none -> /Users/matthewsmith/LOCAL_COURTS/... was found broken. The live directory is cpython-3.11.3-macos-x86_64-none.
LOCAL_COURTS is untracked but NOT covered by any .gitignore rule in this repository. A future `git add -A` in the shared clone would attempt to commit a 332M venv.
caveats.mitigation: HQ should add an ignore rule; this lane did not edit .gitignore because it is outside the declared write terrain

caveats.caveat: Host disk reached 99% utilisation with ~6.3GiB free during this work, down from ~13GiB at start. Constrained disk previously caused a NoviyMac extraction to withhold payloads.
caveats.severity: material operational risk for the later live run

caveats.caveat: The recipe depends on package indexes still serving these exact versions. narwhals is now pinned, closing the specific unpinned-transitive gap, but index availability is not a local guarantee.

durability_verdict: Durably reusable on THIS host at the grain required for a governed live run. Not portable to another host without transferring the interpreter binary.
